discussion_claims.statement: For decades empirical software engineering could rarely show a process effect much bigger than the variation among developers; the intelligence, skill, and context confounds swamped the signal.

Independent practitioner build reports converge on the moves this book teaches — heavy testing, spec-driven development, an environment that enforces its own rules — corroborating that the practices work.
The staged maturity model (CMM/CMMI), under pressure, decays into box-ticking — reaching a level stands in for shipping better software.

Agile's velocity-over-ceremony stance was an accidental-complexity concession — teams shipped fast and kept models thin because holding quality and a current model honest by hand was too expensive at pace.
